---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest a new capability or improvement
title: "[feat] "
labels: ["enhancement"]
---

## Problem

What are you trying to do today, and why is the current workflow painful?

## Proposed solution

What would you like Cadencr to do? A rough sketch is fine — a mockup or user flow is even better.

## Alternatives considered

Other ways this could be solved, and why they fall short.

## Scope

Which part of the app does this touch? (sidebar, diff viewer, planning, a specific agent, backend, landing, ...)

## Anything else

Links, references, or related issues.
